question: Recently, several former senior Armenian political and military officials from Nagorno-Karabakh1 were arrested and detained by the Azerbaijani authorities. Furthermore, there are concerns about whether the international standards for human rights and fair trials are being respected. In light of the above, could the Commission answer the following questions: 1.
What measures does it plan to take to ensure that fundamental rights are respected for all of the Armenian detainees from Nagorno-Karabakh in Azerbaijan?

Does it plan to take concrete measures to facilitate the release of the Armenian prisoners from Nagorno-Karabakh that are being held in Azerbaijan, in particular through diplomatic efforts and by putting pressure on the Azerbaijani authorities to ensure their safe return?
Arkady Ghukasyan, Lyova Mnatsakanyan, Davit Manukyan, Bako Sahakyan, Davit Babayan, Arayik Harutyunyan et Ruben Vardanyan.
answer: The EU continues to support efforts towards the normalisation of relations between Armenia and Azerbaijan on all pending issues. On the situation of detainees from Nagorno-Karabakh, the EU calls on Azerbaijan to respect due process and ensure transparency.

The EU firmly believes that confidence-building measures, including the release of prisoners, can benefit the overall peace process and pave the way for increased confidence between the sides. In this respect, the EU welcomed the joint Armenia-Azerbaijan statement of 7 December 2023 on confidence-building measures, including the exchange of prisoners.

The EU continues to engage with Azerbaijan as part of its regular Human Rights Dialogue as well as in bilateral contacts. The EU continues to call upon Azerbaijan to ensure the rights of Karabakh Armenians, including their right to return to their homes without intimidation and discrimination. The EU has provided over EUR 18 million in humanitarian aid to support the needs of Karabakh Armenians since September 2023.
Arkady Ghukasyan, Lyova Mnatsakanyan, Davit Manukyan, Bako Sahakyan, Davit Babayan, Arayik Harutyunyan et Ruben Vardanyan.
